headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 26, 2026**
article:
The Kansas City Royals secured a thrilling 3-2 victory over the Detroit Tigers, with Hao-Yu Lee leading the offense with 2 home runs and 2 RBIs. The Washington Nationals took down the Arizona Diamondbacks 5-3 behind CJ Abrams' 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels 9-2, with Robbie Ray earning the win after 6.0 innings pitched, 5 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries. Josh Jung, the Texas Rangers' third baseman, has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left calf strain, effective retroactive to July 22, 2026. Additionally, Spencer Arrighetti of the Houston Astros, Juan Soto of the New York Mets, Shawn Armstrong of the Cleveland Guardians, Tanner Banks of the Philadelphia Phillies, Rafael Flores Jr. of the Pittsburgh Pirates, and Brad Keller of the Philadelphia Phillies have all been placed on the injured list due to various injuries.

The Kansas City Royals made a roster move, trading CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash on July 25, 2026. The San Diego Padres traded RHP Ron Marinaccio to the Pittsburgh Pirates for Future Considerations, while the Houston Astros traded RHP Nate Pearson to the Kansas City Royals for RHP Max Martin. The Colorado Rockies traded RHP Seth Halvorsen to the Los Angeles Dodgers for RHP Nick Frasso and OF Landyn Vidourek.

top_news.title: **Royals Edge Tigers in Thrilling 3-2 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals secured a narrow win over the Detroit Tigers, with a final score of 3-2. Hao-Yu Lee led the Royals' offense with a standout performance, hitting 2 home runs and driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Take Down Diamondbacks 5-3**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals secured a 5-3 victory over the Arizona Diamondbacks, with CJ Abrams leading the offense with 3 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Foster Griffin earned the win for the Nationals.

top_news.title: **Giants Rout Angels 9-2**
top_news.summary: The San Francisco Giants dominated the Los Angeles Angels, winning 9-2 behind a strong performance from Robbie Ray, who earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, 5 strikeouts, and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Red Sox 6-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the Boston Red Sox, securing a 6-0 victory behind a strong performance from Dylan Cease. Cease pitched 9.0 innings, striking out 12 batters and allowing just 1 hit.

top_news.title: **Jung Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Texas Rangers third baseman Josh Jung has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left calf strain, effective retroactive to July 22, 2026. Jung's injury will require a minimum 10-day recovery period.

top_news.title: **Royals Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals traded CF Kameron Misner to the Philadelphia Phillies for cash on July 25, 2026.
